 Australia vs England live updates: Brook’s brain explosion leaves everyone stunned
 Liam O'Loughlin Updated November 15, 2026 - 6.12am . First published at 1.35am 
 Powered by Key Updates
 pin 51m ago Brook brain explosion right on cue 
 pin 1h ago Banton brings up classy 50 
 pin 2h ago Duckett’s lifeline wasted as Aussies strike 
 pin 3h ago Teams confirmed for second ODI 
 pin 4h ago ‘Breath of fresh air’ for Aussie cricket 
 pin 5h ago Langer calls for end to Sandpapergate 
 downChevron Show more Latest posts
 27m ago 6.11AM Six, six, wicket as Banton’s luck runs out
 Liam O'Loughlin shares Share post Banton has been the clear shining light for England today and puts the foot down with back-to-back sixes off some short-pitched Bartlett bowling.
 “It’s a bad delivery ... he’s too strong through there,” Mark Waugh said on Fox.
 “They are getting the tactics wrong. He’s not quick enough to bowl there.”
 From the very next ball, Bartlett drops it in short again and Banton hits it to Green in the outfield, who takes a nice low catch. 
 “Maybe it’s not a bad tactic, but it’s a mis-hit from Banton,” Waugh said.
 Banton departs for 121 off 99 deliveries. 
 Tom Banton celebrates a century.  Getty Images 
 51m ago 5.46AM Brook brain explosion right on cue
 Liam O'Loughlin shares Share post England have been going well with the bat, so leave it to captain Brook to come up with a complete brain explosion early in his innings.
 The skipper is dismissed for 5 after attempting a ramp shot off Meredith and chopping it straight onto his own stumps.
 Not what the tourists needed, but they still remain in a solid position as Banton brings up his second ODI century.
 Harry Brook is bowled.  Fox Cricket 
 1h ago 5.34AM Root gone after bizarre shot
 Liam O'Loughlin shares Share post Well, not sure how to sum that up!
 Connolly pitches it on leg-stump to Root, who goes for a big slog and skies it in awkward fashion, with sub fielder Liam Scott taking an easy catch.
 The right-hander departs for 62 off 68 balls, including five boundaries.
 It ends a record-breaking 137-run partnership from Root and Banton, as the highest by an England pair on Australian soil in this format.
 Joe Root is dismissed by Cooper Connolly.  Fox Cricket 
 Advertisement 1h ago 5.22AM Part-timers on in Adelaide
 Liam O'Loughlin shares Share post Matt Renshaw is now rolling the arm over with some right-arm offies.
 Root attempts a reverse-sweep outside off-stump and looks to have gloved it to Inglis behind the stumps, but the keeper can’t take it cleanly.
 Inglis isn’t having the greatest day with the gloves. 
 Josh Inglis drops a tough catch.  Fox Cricket 
 1h ago 5.07AM Root joins the half-century club
 Liam O'Loughlin shares Share post Connolly enters the attack with his left-arm orthodox for the Aussies.
 Root brings up a half-century as well and this England partnership between him and Banton moves past the 100-run mark. 
 “He’s done it with class and style off just 50 balls,” Mark Howard said on Fox.
 Mark Waugh said that Root has “done it easy” as he cruised to the milestone.
 Aussies struggling to break through here on a good Adelaide batting deck.
 1h ago 4.48AM Banton brings up classy 50
 Liam O'Loughlin shares Share post That’s a half-century up for Banton.
 Classy knock so far from the England opener, especially after copping a nasty blow to the helmet earlier in his innings.
 This is a strong partnership and Australia need a wicket soon.
 Tom Banton in action.  Getty Images 
 1h ago 4.44AM Risky moment from Banton
 Liam O'Loughlin shares Share post Zampa has entered the attack now for Australia.
 Banton attempts a risky reverse-sweep on 47 but misses it completely. 
 Root is looking good and is well into the 30s now as England establish control.
 The visitors are 1-94 after 16 overs and that’s drinks at Adelaide Oval.
 Tom Banton’s attempted reverse-sweep.  Fox Cricket 
 2h ago 4.24AM Root gets going, England build momentum
 Liam O'Loughlin shares Share post England are building some momentum now!
 Root moves into the 20s with a boundary off Meredith’s first ball of the afternoon.
 Down the other end, Banton is 33 off 30 balls and is looking to up the ante.
 2h ago 4.13AM Aussie tactics not working on Banton
 Liam O'Loughlin shares Share post Bartlett and Johnson are continuing to pepper Banton with short stuff after his earlier head knock – but it’s not exactly paying off.
 The tall England opener smacks Johnson over square-leg for six and the next over, he top-edges a delivery from Bartlett for another four runs.
 The right-hander seems to be OK despite a bruise quickly forming on his face from the earlier ball that struck him on the helmet. 
 Tom Banton after being struck on the helmet.  Getty Images 
 2h ago 4.09AM Forgotten man backs Warner, Khawaja
 Liam O'Loughlin shares Share post The forgotten man from Australia’s fateful 2018 tour of South Africa has lifted the lid on Sandpapergate – and it’s bad news for Pat Cummins and the bowlers.
 Chadd Sayers, who played his lone Test match in that same series, was part of the touring squad and was in the dressing rooms at Cape Town.
 The 39-year-old has addressed the situation publicly in the past, but his version of events were largely dismissed by those at Cricket Australia.
 Sayers has now firmly backed the stance from both Khawaja and Warner, despite current captain Cummins denying it on Friday morning.
 “I’m comfortable saying where I’m sitting now that everyone knew what was going on,” Sayers told SEN Radio on Sunday afternoon.
